description: This file declares functions and data structures for managing CCSP aliases, including initialization, cleanup, loading alias info, retrieving internal and external names, and managing name lists.

methods.name: CcspAliasMgrInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the alias manager and returns a handle to it.

methods.name: CcspAliasMgrFree
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the alias manager handle.

methods.name: CcspAliasMgrLoadAliasInfo
methods.description: Loads alias information from an XML DOM node into the alias manager.

methods.name: CcspAliasMgrGetInternalNames
methods.description: Retrieves a list of internal names associated with a parameter name.

methods.name: CcspAliasMgrGetNextName
methods.description: Gets the next name in a list of names.

methods.name: CcspAliasMgrGetFirstInternalName
methods.description: Retrieves the first internal name for a given parameter.

methods.name: CcspAliasMgrGetExternalName
methods.description: Obtains the external name associated with a parameter.
